about_the_game:
A Puzzle RPG Where AI Learns from the Player’s Puzzle-Solving Skills

Puzzle RPG Game!

Teach Hoshihabito-kun, a mysterious AI that learns how to solve puzzles, while helping the Friends of BlockWorld—your allies who have turned aggressive due to negative emotions!

Battle Rules

When a puzzle starts, a target number will appear. Drag and swap blocks to move them.
The target number decreases based on the numbers on the moved blocks.
Once the target number reaches zero, a chain reaction begins! Matching three identical blocks triggers a chain combo.

Align three blocks diagonally through the center to activate a skill.

Use SP to Activate Skills and Special Moves

As you progress through the puzzle, you accumulate SP (Skill Points).
Use SP to unleash unique Friend Skills and powerful techniques!

Find Treasures Along the Way

During your journey, you’ll encounter treasures and shops.
Treasures grant special abilities that activate when certain conditions are met in-game.
At shops, exchange Cubes—earned through AI training—for powerful treasures to aid you in battle!

Charge Up and Unleash Devastating Attacks!

When you start a chain, BRAKER mode activates!
During BRAKER, chaining attacks charges your power.
Once the chain ends, BRAKER is released, dealing massive damage!

Trained AI Fights Alongside You in Boss Battles!

The AI learns from the way you solve puzzles, growing stronger as you play.
In boss battles, your trained AI solves puzzles on its own, supporting Hoshihabito-kun and the Friends in battle!
Use skills strategically to assist your Friends and claim victory!
